title: M&T Bank Corporation 8-K — Subordinated Notes Offering
summary: M&T Bank Corporation filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing the closing of a $500,000,000 public offering of 5.295% Fixed Rate Reset Subordinated Notes, Series B, due April 18, 2036. The notes were registered under a Form S-3 registration statement.
key_points: M&T Bank closed a $500,000,000 subordinated notes offering on April 20, 2026
Notes carry a coupon of 5.295% with a fixed-to-floating rate structure
Notes are registered under Securities Act of 1933 via Form S-3 (File No. 333-274646)
Legal opinion provided by Squire Patton Boggs (US) LLP
Filing signed by Daryl N. Bible, Senior EVP and CFO
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate debt issuance disclosure. It has no relevance to Federal Reserve policy, interest rate trajectory, market structure, or broader macro catalysts. The filing serves a securities law compliance purpose—confirming registration and legal opinion for the debt offering. The coupon level (5.295%) reflects current market conditions for regional bank subordinated debt but does not constitute a market signal or catalyst.
